contributions.detail: 3 Schedule A rows sum to 400.00 + 200.00 + 1330.86 = 1,930.86 exactly, matching four printed anchors. THE LOAN LINE DECIDED BY THE LADDER: the third row is written 'Loan to Self'. Line 3 Balance at Beginning is a SLASHED ZERO, so there is no beginning-balance slot to absorb it, and the outside contributions alone sum to 600.00 against the printed 1,930.86 - the side closes only WITH the loan, so it is an itemized contribution row (the Grierson-2012 outcome, not the Witney-2010 one). Classified by the arithmetic, never by the word 'loan'. Column B Year-to-Date prints the same 1,930.86; this is the cycle's FIRST report (the cover ticks 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election' and line 3 is zero), so period IS year-to-date and no scope distinction arises - this is not a cumulative-exact side.
